target_customer: Homeowners at launch, then large building owners and corporations wanting to cut energy, water and emissions
problem: People and building operators lacked granular data on electricity, gas and water use, so they could not cut utility bills or emissions.
business_model: Hardware sensors plus software subscription and enterprise data services
product_category: IoT energy and water sensors with AI optimization

founders.name: Manuel Schoenfeld
founders.background_notes: German entrepreneur described by Antler as a former management consultant who started on a hydrogen scooter idea in a 2019 Antler New York residency before moving to utility savings.

investors: Tesla and SpaceX executives as individuals

technical_complexity.rationale: Custom sensor hardware plus a data and AI layer for several utilities needs hardware, firmware and software skills, but the sensing techniques were established.

defensibility.rationale: The company claimed proprietary sensor data, but consumer and building energy monitors were available from several vendors and no strong moat is evidenced.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No evidence of an incumbent copying or buying it. The YC directory lists it as acquired but no acquirer or date was found.

market_need_then: Utility costs and corporate emissions targets were rising concerns, and a 2021 press release claimed a family of four could save an average of 1000 dollars a year on utilities. Evidence of paying demand at the batch date was not found.

branding.domain_note: Used powerx.co, which now redirects to a dashboard subdomain. Many unrelated companies use the PowerX name, including a Japanese battery storage firm.

identity.voice_and_tone: Savings focused consumer messaging in 2021 press

brand_strength.rationale: Name is generic and shared by several unrelated firms, and no brand coverage or community was found.

pivots.from: Home utility sensors and AI optimization for consumers
pivots.to: Enterprise sensors for corporations and building operators
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred only from the change between 2021 press and the YC tagline, so treat as unverified

outcome_analysis: PowerX raised a 4 million dollar seed in April 2021 backed by Spring Tide Capital and Antler and sold sensors for home and later corporate energy savings. The YC directory marks it acquired but searches found no acquirer, date or price, and one profile still lists the founder as CEO, so the outcome is unclear and the cause cannot be assigned.
notes: Acquisition per YC directory is unconfirmed by any other source found; search turned up unrelated companies named PowerX, so the deals found were not attributed. Round cross-check is Crunchbase News and VCA Online, both on the same press release. Aggregator later rounds and a 30M valuation are unverified and excluded. No dated competitor sources found near the batch. Pivot entry is inferred and weak. powerx.co redirects to a bare dashboard page.
